ideas.pitch: An interactive logic puzzle and algorithmic workflow visualizer for computer science education.
ideas.title: LogicGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of creating educational tools that directly benefit students and teachers, similar to aura.

ideas.pitch: A real-time logic rule engine that triggers webhook workflows based on streaming IoT or telemetry events.
ideas.title: StreamLogic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard backend engineering and a working live demo of low-latency event processing.

ideas.pitch: An LLM-as-a-judge microservice designed to automatically evaluate and score hackathon submissions against rubric constraints.
ideas.title: FlowJudger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies proven LLM evaluation architectures from winning entries to an automated grading use case.

ideas.pitch: A paperless administrative workflow portal for managing university resource requests and inventory tracking.
ideas.title: CampusFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the practical campus management utility that won major prizes at competitive inter-college hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined onboarding utility that verifies user wallet eligibility and routes transactions via real-time workflows.
ideas.title: BaseLogic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an end-to-end worry-free workflow model focused on clean commercial utility and smooth UX.
